import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

trips = tables['trips']
pier = tables['pier']

# Last 30 days fleet performance (doy 183-213)
recent_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_doy'].between(183, 213)]
recent_perf = recent_trips.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
}).reset_index()
recent_perf['yt_per_angler'] = recent_perf['yt'] / recent_perf['anglers']

print("=== LAST 30 DAYS FLEET (doy 183-213) ===")
print(recent_perf.groupby('cls')['yt_per_angler'].agg(['count', 'mean', 'max', 'min']).round(3))
print()

# Peak season historical performance (doy 260-299 from S1/S2)
peak_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_doy'].between(260, 299)]
peak_perf = peak_trips.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
}).reset_index()
peak_perf['yt_per_angler'] = peak_perf['yt'] / peak_perf['anglers']

print("=== HISTORICAL PEAK SEASON (doy 260-299) ===")
print(peak_perf.groupby('cls')['yt_per_angler'].agg(['count', 'mean', 'max', 'min']).round(3))
print()

# Overall stats
print("=== OVERALL PEAK vs RECENT ===")
recent_avg = recent_trips['yt'].sum() / recent_trips['anglers'].sum() if len(recent_trips) > 0 else 0
peak_avg = peak_trips['yt'].sum() / peak_trips['anglers'].sum() if len(peak_trips) > 0 else 0
print(f"Recent avg (doy 183-213): {recent_avg:.3f} yt/angler")
print(f"Peak avg (doy 260-299): {peak_avg:.3f} yt/angler")
print(f"Peak/Recent ratio: {peak_avg/recent_avg:.1f}x" if recent_avg > 0 else "Inf")
print()

# Water temp trend (last 30 days)
recent_temps = pier[pier['ts_doy'].between(183, 213)].copy()
recent_temps = recent_temps.sort_values('ts_t')
if len(recent_temps) > 0:
    print("=== WATER TEMP (Scripps Pier) ===")
    print(f"doy 183 earliest: {recent_temps.iloc[0]['wtmp_c']:.1f}°C")
    print(f"doy 213 latest: {recent_temps.iloc[-1]['wtmp_c']:.1f}°C")
    print(f"Min/Max: {recent_temps['wtmp_c'].min():.1f}°C / {recent_temps['wtmp_c'].max():.1f}°C")
